notes: Cartoon beaver in a green T-shirt; open 5-finger hands skinned to one hand bone each (no finger bones). Source bone names are generic: the LEFT arm chain is Bone_001_R_004 (clavicle) -> Bone_001_R_005 -> Bone_001_R_006 -> Bone_001_R_007 despite the _R in its name; the right arm is Bone_001_R -> Bone_001_R_001 -> _002 -> _003. Bone_L / Bone_R are pelvis-side hip bones above the thighs (Bone_L_001.._003 = left thigh, shin, foot). The single source spine bone (coluna = 'spine' in Portuguese) was split into coluna (role hips) + coluna_upper (role spine). Flat paddle tail with a 4-bone chain. Rest pose rebuilt from the bind pose (T-pose). Facing +Z (glTF/Godot), +Y up, metres; soles at y=0, centred between the feet. Top of skull at y=1.000 (ears/hats excluded), crown point (x -0.000, y 1.000, z -0.031); head width 0.307 m, depth 0.329 m; head bone origin at (x 0.000, y 0.680, z -0.016). Rest pose T (upper arm 17 deg below horizontal). 25 bones, 12858 triangles. Bone local axes follow Blender's convention (+Y along each bone towards its child).
